units.title: SG-7.2 · Extend the worker config with work root, budget, auto-publish and provider kind
Act: Add work root, max budget, auto-publish and provider kind fields with defaults
Act: Validate execution timeout, retries, budget and provider kind in LoadFS
Verify: Worker config new-field defaults and overrides unit tests

tests.name: TestLoadFS_NewFieldDefaults
tests.title: LoadFS fills work_root, max_budget, auto_publish and provider_kind with defaults when only repo_path is set
tests.scenario: Given a YAML config with only worker.repo_path set, when LoadFS runs with no env overrides, then WorkRoot is '.storyforge/work', MaxBudget is 5, AutoPublish is false and ProviderKind is 'mock'

tests.name: TestLoadFS_NewFieldExplicit
tests.title: LoadFS keeps explicit work_root, max_budget, auto_publish and provider_kind values from YAML
tests.scenario: Given a YAML config setting repo_path /r, work_root /w, max_budget 12.5, auto_publish true and provider_kind claude, when LoadFS runs, then each field equals its input value

units.title: Verify: Worker config validation unit tests

tests.name: TestLoadFS_Validation
tests.title: rejects a negative execution_timeout and names the key
tests.scenario: Given worker.repo_path plus execution_timeout: -1m, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error mentioning execution_timeout

tests.name: TestLoadFS_Validation
tests.title: rejects a negative max_retries and names the key
tests.scenario: Given worker.repo_path plus max_retries: -1, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error mentioning max_retries

tests.name: TestLoadFS_Validation
tests.title: rejects a negative max_budget and names the key
tests.scenario: Given worker.repo_path plus max_budget: -1, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error mentioning max_budget

tests.name: TestLoadFS_Validation
tests.title: rejects an unknown provider_kind and names the key
tests.scenario: Given worker.repo_path plus provider_kind: gpt, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error mentioning provider_kind

tests.name: TestLoadFS_ValidProviders
tests.title: accepts the mock and claude provider kinds and keeps the input value
tests.scenario: Given worker.repo_path plus provider_kind mock or claude, when LoadFS runs, then it returns no error and ProviderKind equals the input
